title: Check Z-Axis Motor Positioning Within the Frame (Tipper Commissioning)
summary: On the OptiSweep tipper operator station HMI, use the Visu_MCP_Dual (F3) jogging screen to jog the Z-axis upward using the '+' button until it is as close as possible to the overtravel switch without the motor hitting the frame. If the motor reaches the overtravel switch, move it back down approximately 1/3 in.
when_to_use: Use during tipper commissioning when verifying the Z-axis motor can travel close to the overtravel switch without contacting the frame.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Executes HMI jogging actions (CYCLE STOP, JOG, '+' button) and verifies motor clearance relative to the frame/overtravel switch.
safety_notes: Stop jogging and escalate if the motor hits the frame during movement.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the OptiSweep tipper HMI (Visu_MCP_Dual screen).
Ability to observe motor position relative to the frame and identify the overtravel switch.

steps.title: Navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual (F3)
steps.purpose: Open the correct tipper operator station screen used for jogging the Z-axis.
steps.instruction: On the tipper operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen using F3.
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI is on the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen and ready for jogging controls.
steps.failure_condition: The HMI is not on the "Visu_MCP_Dual" (F3) screen, or the jogging controls are not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.9: CHECKING MOTOR POSITIONING WITHIN THE FRAME 1. Navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen (F3).

steps.title: Open the jogging screen (CYCLE STOP then JOG)
steps.purpose: Enable manual jogging controls for the Z-axis.
steps.instruction: On the "Visu_MCP_Dual" (F3) screen, press CYCLE STOP and then press JOG to open the jogging screen.
steps.expected_result: The jogging screen is open and jogging controls are available.
steps.healthy_condition: Jogging screen is active (controls for jogging are visible).
steps.failure_condition: Jogging screen does not open after pressing CYCLE STOP and JOG.

actions.label: Press CYCLE STOP then JOG
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP then JOG to open the jogging screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.9: CHECKING MOTOR POSITIONING WITHIN THE FRAME 2. Press CYCLE STOP then JOG to open the jogging screen.

steps.title: Jog Z-axis upward close to the overtravel switch without hitting the frame
steps.purpose: Verify Z-axis clearance relative to the frame and overtravel switch.
steps.instruction: Jog the Z-axis for the tipper using the '+' button as far as it will go without the motor hitting the frame.
steps.expected_result: The Z-axis is positioned such that it does not hit the frame while being jogged upward as far as possible.
steps.healthy_condition: Motor movement stops short of contacting the frame; the overtravel switch is approached without impact.
steps.failure_condition: The motor hits the frame during jogging.

actions.label: Jog Z-axis with '+'
actions.exact_action: Jog the Z-axis for the tipper using the '+' button as far as it will go without the motor hitting the frame.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the motor hits the frame during jogging, stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.9: CHECKING MOTOR POSITIONING WITHIN THE FRAME 3. Jog the Z-axis for the tipper using the '+' button as far as it will go without the motor hitting the frame.

steps.title: If Z-axis reaches overtravel switch, move it back down ~1/3 in
steps.purpose: Set a safe Z-axis position when the overtravel switch is reached.
steps.instruction: If the motor is able to travel all the way to the overtravel switch, move it back down approximately 1/3 in.
steps.expected_result: The Z-axis is backed down approximately 1/3 in from the overtravel-switch-reaching position.
steps.healthy_condition: Motor is positioned below the overtravel switch location by approximately 1/3 in (as observed/estimated during jogging).
steps.failure_condition: Z-axis remains at/at beyond the overtravel switch position (no back-down adjustment).

actions.label: Back down approximately 1/3 in
actions.exact_action: If the motor is able to travel all the way to the overtravel switch, move it back down approximately 1/3 in.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.9: CHECKING MOTOR POSITIONING WITHIN THE FRAME 3. ... If the motor is able to travel all the way to the overtravel switch, move it back down approximately 1/3 in.

success_criteria: Z-axis can be jogged upward close to the overtravel switch without the motor hitting the frame.
If the overtravel switch is reached, the Z-axis is moved back down approximately 1/3 in.
healthy_conditions: During jogging, the motor does not contact the frame.
When the overtravel switch is reached, the motor is backed down approximately 1/3 in.
failure_conditions: Motor hits the frame during jogging.
Overtravel switch is reached and the motor is not backed down approximately 1/3 in.
escalation_guidance: If the motor hits the frame during jogging, stop and escalate for support.
